// defect: An `errors` that holds one error rather than a list of them. No reporter writes it; the case holds how the field is read. Every other field a report promises as a list is read as an empty one when it is not, which refuses a report whose cases it holds; read that way, this one would pass the run. So it is read as the one error it holds, here the sentence of a `globalTimeout` that ran out in the last worker's teardown with every test run (measured) — a whole number of seconds, in the second suite.

fake-docs-e2e.message: Timed out waiting 7200s for the test suite to run
